content.title: Cricket 24
content.text: Select your platform: Select your version: Edition Standard Edition PC Digital About the game Description Cricket 24 is the culmination of a decade of cricket video game development, featuring teams from around the world. Players can experience major cricket nations such as Australia and England in the official Ashes tournament, as well as the West Indies, New Zealand, Ireland, and more. For the first time, players will also be able to experience professional Indian T20 teams, all set in over 50 detailed official stadiums. Cricket 24 is the most comprehensive cricket video game simulation ever made. More information Category Sport Studio Big Ant Studios Publisher Nacon Rating PEGI 3+ , ESRB E Language English Release date October 5, 2023 Required configuration Minimum Operating System Windows 10 or Windows 11 Processor Intel i3 2100 (3.1 GHz) / AMD FX 6300 (3.5 GHz) RAM 8 GB of RAM Graphics NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770 (4 GB) / AMD Radeon R9 270 (4 GB) Storage 60 GB of available disk space DirectX Version 12 Additional Notes Although not mandatory, an SSD is recommended for storage.
